units.source_text: 源氏公子仔细寻思：

en.t: Prince Genji thought it over carefully:

units.source_text: 如果风声泄露，这件事被紫姬闻知，

en.t: If rumors got out and Lady Murasaki heard of this affair,

units.source_text: 我虽然是逢场作戏，她一定恨我欺瞒她，

en.t: even though it was only a passing amusement for me, she would surely resent me for deceiving her,

units.source_text: 因而疏远我，这倒是对她不起的，并且在我也是可耻的。

en.t: and if she grew distant from me because of it, I would have wronged her, and it would be shameful for me as well.

units.source_text: 由此可知他对紫姬爱情特别深厚。

en.t: From this one can see how especially deep his love for Lady Murasaki was.

units.source_text: 他回想过去：

en.t: He thought back on the past:

units.source_text: “那时我常做不端之事，使得这位宽宏大量的夫人也时时为我而懊恼。

en.t: At that time I often behaved improperly, and even this generous lady was repeatedly distressed because of me.

units.source_text: 我为什么要做这种无聊消遣，使她如此受气呢？”

en.t: Why did I indulge in such foolish diversions and make her suffer so much?

units.source_text: 后悔之余，虽然面对明石姬的芳姿，

en.t: Filled with regret, even when he faced Lady Akashi's lovely figure,

units.source_text: 也不能慰藉对紫姬的恋慕。

en.t: it could not soothe his longing for Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 便写一封比平常更加详细的信给她，

en.t: So he wrote her a letter more detailed than usual,

units.source_text: 信中有云：

en.t: in which he wrote:

units.source_text: “我真无颜启口：

en.t: I truly have no face to speak of this:

units.source_text: 往日疏狂成性，做下种种不端行为，屡屡劳君忧恼。

en.t: In the past, recklessness became my nature, and I committed all sorts of improper acts, again and again causing you worry and pain.

units.source_text: 回想起来，已觉痛心难堪，

en.t: When I look back on it, I already feel heartsick and ashamed,

units.source_text: 岂知今日在此远浦，又做了这个无聊的噩梦！

en.t: yet who would have thought that today, on this distant shore, I would again have this foolish nightmare!

units.source_text: 今我不问自招，先将此事奉告，

en.t: Now, before being asked, I confess of my own accord and first report this matter to you,

units.source_text: 务请体察我这点诚实之心，委屈原谅！

en.t: so please understand this small sincerity of mine and, however painful it may be, forgive me!

units.source_text: 正如古歌所云：

en.t: Just as the old poem says:

units.source_text: ‘我心倘背白头誓，天地神明请共诛。’”

en.t: If my heart should betray the vow we made until white-haired old age, may the gods of heaven and earth together punish me.

units.source_text: 后面又写道：

en.t: Later he wrote again:

units.source_text: “总之，我是

en.t: In short, I am
